SELECT er.* FROM biz_contract_expiry_rule er WHERE er.del_flag = '0'
AND er.rule_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{ruleName}, '%')
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ics_building b WHERE b.park_id = #{parkId} AND FIND_IN_SET(CAST(b.id AS CHAR), REPLACE(COALESCE(er.building_ids, ''), 'building_', '')) > 0 )
ORDER BY er.create_time DESC, er.rule_id DESC
